query:
-- Verificar fuel_record_containers para galão 3
SELECT frc.id, frc.fuel_record_id, frc.gallon_number, frc.liters_used, ROUND(frc.liters_used/100, 2) as liters_L
FROM fuel_record_containers frc
WHERE frc.gallon_number = 3
ORDER BY frc.id;

-- Verificar se existem containers órfãos (sem fuel_record pai)
SELECT frc.id, frc.fuel_record_id, frc.gallon_number, frc.liters_used
FROM fuel_record_containers frc
LEFT JOIN fuel_records fr ON frc.fuel_record_id = fr.id
WHERE fr.id IS NULL;

-- Total de abastecimentos por galão considerando containers
SELECT 
  gallon_number,
  SUM(liters_used) as total_liters,
  ROUND(SUM(liters_used)/100, 2) as total_L,
  COUNT(*) as qtd
FROM fuel_record_containers
GROUP BY gallon_number;
